closed.title: Latest verified release baseline
closed.detail: v2.3.52 exists and the repository version is 2.3.52.

closed.title: ZXP signing lane
closed.detail: Release workflow restores the ZXP signing certificate, signs the ZXP and runs a ZXP signature-proof gate.

closed.title: macOS trust architecture
closed.detail: The macOS lane uses Developer ID signing/notarization/stapling checks and should be preserved during Windows hardening.

pending.title: Windows Authenticode signing is not proven
pending.detail: v2.3.52 build-win-installer.mjs sets CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false and tolerates electron-builder signing failure before creating the Inno wrapper.

pending.title: Final Windows EXE signature verification missing
pending.detail: The release workflow validates the EXE exists and bans MSI output but has no shown Authenticode sign/verify gate for the final installer.

pending.title: Hidden PowerShell UAC relaunch
pending.detail: Installer main.js uses powershell.exe with -WindowStyle Hidden and Start-Process -Verb RunAs for self-elevation.

pending.title: AV / sandbox heuristic risk
pending.detail: Unsigned/low-reputation executable packaging combined with hidden PowerShell, UAC elevation, process enumeration and filesystem mutation can produce aggressive behavioral classifications.

pending.title: Process-injection allegation
pending.detail: No classic remote-process injection implementation was found in the installer paths inspected. The VirusTotal behavioral wording still requires exact artifact/report analysis before dismissal.

pending.title: Gumroad artifact provenance
pending.detail: The exact Gumroad ZIP hash has not yet been compared with the GitHub release artifact hash.

pending.title: Release pattern hardening
pending.detail: Future distribution must add mandatory Windows signing, fail-closed verification, provenance, install smoke and AV/reputation review before Gumroad publication.

next_acceptance.question: Can a newly built Windows installer prove trusted signatures on the inner Electron executable and final Inno installer and pass clean-machine installation without hidden-PowerShell dependency?
next_acceptance.observable: Authenticode verification output for both executables, matching SHA-256 provenance, clean Windows install/upgrade/uninstall smoke results, and post-sign AV/reputation review tied to the exact artifact hash.
next_acceptance.falsifier: The release proceeds when signing fails, signatures are absent/untrusted, provenance cannot be matched, or the current hidden-PowerShell path remains the only elevation mechanism without explicit acceptance.
